svg.aria-label: From one ask to a release, in seven stops: you ask, the ledger saves it word for word, the budget level sets the helpers, a critic reviews the plan, Claude builds, a fresh reviewer says PASS or FAIL, and you decide to ship. FAIL goes back to build; PASS closes the item. Guards run on every tool call

text.font-family: ui-rounded, 'SF Pro Rounded', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif
